_about: KOMBI (Audi RS 6 Avant C8): its Virtual Cockpit and its upper MMI screen are blank in the model (each a quad of the interior's material, its UVs collapsed onto one patch of the texture), so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital cluster in Audi red, the centre screen's pages.
